تتمنطقين (form IIq)
# تَتَمَنْطَقِينَ (tatamanṭaqīna) /ta.ta.man.tˤa.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# تُتَمَنْطَقِينَ (tutamanṭaqīna) /tu.ta.man.tˤa.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
